errors.text: The fracture-morphology assignment is reversed: the target associates the HPHT-induced ductile response with distributed/isolated microcracking rather than elongated catastrophic cracks, whereas the generated hypothesis assigns isolated microcracks to the brittle baseline and elongated cracks to the treated alloy.
The cited evidence does not substantiate the central material-specific claim that 6 GPa and 1473 K produce hierarchical coherent FCC/B2 interfaces in Al0.7CoCrFeNi.
